body:
Reopened. The gap is wider than the title says: nothing ever creates a session's info record in either reducer, so every write into `info` is a no-op, not only cost and tokens.

What was checked (main at 2c4585f):

- `internal/sessionstate/reduce.go`: every write to `p.state.Info[sessionID]` is guarded on the record already existing (`session.usage.updated` at line 84, and the same guard for agent, model, permissions, revert, location). No case in the reducer inserts a record. `state.go` only initializes the empty map and deletes from it.
- `web/src/lib/sessionstate/index.ts`: same shape, same guards (`session.usage.updated` at line 48). Nothing assigns `state.info[sid]`.
- Nothing outside the reducers seeds `Info` either.
- The core does emit `session.usage.updated` with the correct running total (`session.go:255-263`, `usage.go`). It lands in the observation store's own per-session map (`internal/observation/usage.go`), which is what the page reads (`web/src/lib/observation/SessionTimeline.svelte:18-22`, `web/src/routes/runs/[runID]/+page.svelte`). So the page is right, and the reducer is bypassed.

Why: in OpenCode the session record reaches the reducer from the session API, ahead of any step events. Gimble emits nothing that stands in for it. Pinned upstream is at `c55ee2a8` (`internal/sessionstate/NOTICE.md` lists the ported files); a read-only checkout of it exists at `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tyler-src-gimble--claude-worktrees-issue-149-plan-673991/f73f851a-9166-4b65-8321-407aae106ffa/scratchpad/opencode/packages` while that session's scratchpad lives, and `third_party/opencode/prepare.sh` fetches it otherwise.

Desired outcome: the reducer's session info actually carries cost and tokens (and the other info fields) for a Gimble session, with one source of truth for session totals. How to get there is for whoever picks this up to work out from the upstream.

Closed by decision in #173: the observation store is the contract (session totals in `RunInfo.Usage`, turn totals on the invocation, scope totals as sums of turns); reducer `info` stays unseeded and the ports are not edited.
